paragraphs.title: Orders per minute
paragraphs.text:
%store
SELECT strftime('%H:%M', o._timestamp / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS minute, count(*) AS orders
FROM "shop-orders" o
WHERE o._timestamp >= unixepoch('now', '-15 minutes') * 1000
GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute

paragraphs.title: Revenue by product
paragraphs.text:
%store
SELECT p.name AS product, round(sum(i.quantity * i.unit_price_cents) / 100.0, 2) AS revenue
FROM "shop-order-items" i JOIN "shop-products" p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE i._timestamp >= unixepoch('now', '-15 minutes') * 1000
GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC

paragraphs.title: Deliveries: late versus on time
paragraphs.text:
%store
SELECT CASE WHEN s.delivered_at > s.promised_at THEN 'Late' ELSE 'On time' END AS delivery,
count(*) AS shipments FROM "shop-shipments" s
WHERE s._timestamp >= unixepoch('now', '-15 minutes') * 1000
GROUP BY delivery ORDER BY delivery

paragraphs.title: Orders, customers and payments
paragraphs.text:
%store
SELECT c.name AS customer, o.order_id, round(p.amount_cents / 100.0, 2) AS paid
FROM "shop-orders" o JOIN "shop-customers" c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN "shop-payments" p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o._timestamp >= unixepoch('now', '-15 minutes') * 1000
AND p._timestamp >= unixepoch('now', '-15 minutes') * 1000
ORDER BY o._timestamp DESC LIMIT 20

paragraphs.title: Current compacted product and stock
paragraphs.text:
%store
SELECT p.product_id, p.name, s.quantity FROM "shop-products" p
JOIN "shop-stock" s ON p.product_id = s.product_id
WHERE p.product_id = 'p01'
